expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is a staged milestone plan (M0–M5 + S1/S2 table), with a coaching loop: 「概念讲解(3-6句) → 给骨架 → 我自己写核心 → 跑验收命令 → 按真实输出调试 → 2-3句复盘」 and 「我没尝试之前，核心代码由我写；我明确求助时才给当前任务的完整代码」. No complete server implementation was written — only skeleton snippets (e.g. the fixed response header snippet) plus acceptance commands per milestone.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Final answer ends with a runnable checkpoint: 「验收: head -40 python-webserver-tasks.md … 期望输出：标题、原文新链接、gist 链接和开场白模板」. Each milestone also ends with concrete commands and expected output, e.g. M0 「python3 --version # 输出 Python 3.x」.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (web-server-http): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones match the article's actual stages: M1 「HTTP 就是文本」reproduces the article's own POST demo (Content-Length: 21, name=John&surname=Doe), M2 socket 监听+固定响应, M3 index.html, M4 解析请求行, M5 404 — matching the fetched article.txt (「HTTP is just text」, GET/POST examples). Uses tutorial-specific artifacts: htdocs/ with index.html and ipsum.html, Python 3 socket stdlib only, the author's real gist link and the verified zip URL (HTTP 200 check in shell log).

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run and the task list correctly says 「不代替我运行 pip/apt/brew 等安装命令」. But the agent ran: curl -sL --max-time 25 "https://web.archive.org/web/2017id_/…" -o /tmp/article.html — writing outside the project dir (/tmp), which violates the workspace-only rule.
